statement.forward: Every bofop has a unique measurable fiber family with (Af)(x)=integral f dnu_x and ||A||infinity->infinity=||A||1->1=ess sup_x nu_x(Omega)<infinity.
statement.converse: A bounded fiber family whose induced operator is symmetric defines a bofop.

proof_scope.general_standard_Borel_certificate: Construct the joint measure from the positive bilinear form, extend it, disintegrate it on the standard Borel space, prove uniqueness with a countable generator, and derive both norms from positivity and duality without assuming Theorem 3.3.
proof_scope.finite_atomic_certificate: For every finite n, positive probability vector mu, and nonnegative matrix A satisfying detailed balance, nu_i({j})=A_ij is the unique fiber family and the three exact norms all equal max_i sum_j A_ij.
proof_scope.uniqueness: Testing the representation on every atom indicator e_j identifies every fiber atom, so no finite signal-grid assumption is used.
proof_scope.scaling: The same certificate is exercised on 34 dense and sparse instances through 16,384 vertices, including nonuniform reversible measures.

acceptance: both proof kernels derive the arbitrary-standard-Borel target from the enumerated foundation lemmas
deleting extension, disintegration, uniqueness, the positive-kernel norm, or duality makes the certificate fail
the uncountable circle graphing has measurable singular two-point fibers with exact mass one
derive every fiber and its uniqueness from the atom-indicator basis
check the fiber integral identity for every real signal by coefficient equality

reject a self-adjoint positive graphop with genuinely unbounded fibers
